title: Seeley by the Sea
meta_description: Spacious coastal retreat just minutes from the beach! Sleeps 12+, gourmet kitchen, spa-style baths, balconies, grill area \& all the comforts of home.
description_expanded:
Welcome to your dream getaway! This spacious, light-filled home offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and coastal charm. Nestled in a peaceful, upscale neighborhood just minutes from the beach, this retreat is ideal for families, groups, or couples looking to relax, reconnect, and recharge.

Inside, you'll find bright, open-concept living spaces with high ceilings and stylish decor, creating a breezy, inviting atmosphere. The gourmet kitchen features sleek quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a large island perfect for cooking, gathering, or enjoying a casual meal. With five beautifully appointed bedrooms---including a luxurious primary suite with a spa-style bathroom---everyone will have their own peaceful space to unwind. Multiple full bathrooms offer walk-in showers, double vanities, and even a soaking tub for the ultimate relaxation.

For added convenience, the home includes in-home laundry, high-speed Wi-Fi, smart TVs, and all the comforts of home. Step outside to enjoy covered balconies and porches where you can sip your morning coffee or wind down at sunset. A private grill and outdoor seating area make it easy to enjoy alfresco dining or a casual barbecue, while the garage comes stocked with a ping pong table and bikes for added fun and enjoyment.

Located just a short walk or bike ride from the beach, the home is perfectly positioned in a quiet neighborhood surrounded by nature. You'll be close to charming local restaurants, coffee shops, boutiques, and plenty of outdoor adventures.

Whether you're unwinding on the balcony with a glass of wine, preparing a beachside brunch in the gourmet kitchen, or sinking into plush beds after a sun-soaked day, this home is designed to make your stay unforgettable!

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Please note: The minimum age requirement to book this property is 25 years old.

Parking Details:
- 2 spots in driveway.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
